name: Signet Ring
description: A solid signet ring in brushed gold metal with a wide, smooth, high-polish flat face and a plain unmarked band.
materials: Solid brushed-gold metal band with a smooth, high-polish flat face
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, engraving, stamp, hallmark, monogram, or maker's mark anywhere on the ring, inside or outside the band; never add a stone or applied ornament to the flat face; never let the brushed texture read as scratched, pitted, or damaged. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the flat outer face perfectly smooth and completely blank in every angle; keep the brushed-vs-polished texture contrast between band and face identical and consistent across all four shots. When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
